snippet.title: Moth - Soon available in Steam!
snippet.description:
First teaser of my upcoming (PC) horror game Moth. A psychological thriller with a twist in the end.

In Moth you play as a police investigator searching the underground parking hall for a murderer.
Soon you will find out that absolutely nothing is what it seems.
What has really happened? What is the crime?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3625420/Moth/
